heroIntro: Give your AI agent your team’s way of working. Use the iO skills to agree on behaviour, review prototypes together and ship tested software.
workflowIntro: Work in two overlapping loops. While you refine one part with the client, your team can already build and test another.
phaseTriggers: When a request is still open
whyTitle: How the spec helps the team
why: A decision from a demo goes into the spec first. The team can trace the agreed behaviour to the release that implements it.
In a prototype review, the retailer and project team open the same comparison at phone width. The retailer can point to a button that makes it unclear which light will go into the basket.
An acceptance example describes what someone should see or do. The team uses that same example to build, test and review the change.
guidesIntro: A bike retailer wants customers to compare two distinct models in the same category. Develop the feature from a brief or add it to the existing webshop. Follow the example prompts to compare lights, bags and locks and place a test order.
catalogTitle: Find a skill for your task.
catalogIntro: Search by name or by what you want to do. Each skill includes an example prompt, the expected output and its installation command.
emptyHelp: Try another search term or choose a different phase.
installIntro: Run this command in your project directory using a GitHub account with access to the iO Skills repository.
